notes: Bhishma Parva opening / Bhagavad Gita. Krishna charioteer + teacher (pitambar, peacock, garland, reins — never flute-primary). Arjuna gold crown lock (dark mustache, cream-white dhoti, quiver, Gandiva — never flower garland). Vishvarupa tasteful comic radiance not horror. No gore battle focus — sacred teaching on the field. Locks already ≥1536×1024 on disk (historic quality bar).

krishna.face: Youthful divine smile, dark eyes, serene — same face every plate, comic mythology, not photoreal
krishna.costume: Yellow pitambar dhoti, flower garland, charioteer reins — never flute-primary, never bow

arjuna.face: Noble warrior prince, dark mustache, expressive eyes (grief then resolve) — same face every plate
arjuna.hair: Gold crown over dark hair (lock — not loose un-crowned hair)
arjuna.costume: Cream-white dhoti, gold belt, quiver on back, Gandiva — never flower garland, never peacock

armies.costume: Muted army ranks, banners — equal human scale

chariot.costume: White horses, ornate Pandava chariot with Krishna as driver — scene continuity across plates
